description: This file defines a module for interacting with an API to retrieve a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user. It exports an async function 'listOrganizations' that makes a GET request to the '/session/tenants' endpoint, normalizes various possible data structures, and returns a sorted array of organization objects with 'id' and 'name'.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations for the current user by calling the '/session/tenants' API endpoint, normalizing different data structures, and sorting the resulting array by organization name and id.
